correctness.rationale: The exact local majority update is AND of rim neighbours at hub 0 and OR at hub 1; the hub changes on strict rim majority. The symmetric-coupling two-time Lyapunov argument establishes eventual period ≤2, with a self-diagonal <1 to encode tie retention. Constant hub gives exactly the two unanimous fixed states and two exceptional even-rim primitive cycles. For hub zero to flip and return, a rim word must have k>n/2, e=Σ x_i x_(i+2)<n/2, and no isolated occupied vertex under step-two adjacency. The polynomial R_m counts cyclic one-runs ≥2 via m/r binomial run compositions; even n gives two independent step-two cycles and R_(n/2)^2. These identities prove the exact claimed formula for all n≥4; independent direct graph dynamics checks n=4..11 reproduce orbit counts 2,5,11,21,34,66,77,220.
